name: MASTER1576_TWO_HOUR_RANGE_TRANSLATION_AND_ACTIVITY_IMPACT_DECELERATION_WAVE_V1
selection_basis: Prospective causal extraction and complete available inputs; no confidential leaves, best lags, weeks, symbols or observed A/B signs used to choose directions or parameters

mechanisms.definition: For two adjacent fully elapsed UTC hours H1=H-3600 and H2=H, aggregate each from exactly twelve M5 bars: O=first open, C=last close, L=min low, U=max high. Long iff L2>L1 AND U2>U1 AND C2>O2. Short iff L2<L1 AND U2<U1 AND C2<O2. Otherwise abstain. Strict comparisons; no fitted thresholds.
mechanisms.causal_hypothesis: Both traded range endpoints relocate together and the completed hourly body agrees: continuation of sustained directional price discovery.
mechanisms.distinctness: Uses consecutive actual H1 high/low range geometry, not sign-only H4/H1/M15 alignment, M5 z-score, return lookback crossover, opening-range breakout, thresholded wick rejection, or weighted M5 signs. May trigger with close inside prior range; does not require breakout or reverse old A.

mechanisms.definition: For the same H1/H2 define rj=ln(Cj/Oj), Vj=sum native tick_volume, Ij=abs(rj)/Vj. Require V1,V2>0, r1*r2>0, abs(r2)>abs(r1), V2>V1 and I2<I1. Then direction=-sign(r2); otherwise abstain. Compare ratios by cross multiplication abs(r2)*V1<abs(r1)*V2; no fitted multipliers.
mechanisms.causal_hypothesis: A same-direction accelerating move needs disproportionately more broker-native activity; declining displacement per activity is a prospective exhaustion/absorption hypothesis.
mechanisms.distinctness: New two-hour joint elasticity state. Not one-M5 volume-shock/median-multiplier reversal or its target/adaptive exit; not a reversal of the closed hourly activity-weighted direction. No large-volume rank or threshold selected from returns.
